translations.error.RECORDING_INCOMPLETE: Some parts of this recording were not uploaded yet. Wait for the upload to finish, or save what was recorded before the missing part.
translations.error.VALIDATION_ERROR: Some values are not valid. Check the fields and try again.
translations.error.api_unreachable: Narrastep could not reach the local service. Check that Narrastep is running.

translations.export.title: Export
translations.export.intro: A package holds the reviewed transcript, the screenshots, the source details and prompts that tell a language model to use only this evidence.
translations.export.batches_help: Long recordings are also split into ChatGPT batches in time order. Each batch fits in one message: one evidence file and up to 19 images by default.
translations.export.include_video_removed: The original video was removed from this computer, so it cannot be included.
translations.export.include_video_help: Off by default. The video can make the package much larger.
translations.export.approximate: Approximate: the final size can differ.
translations.export.redundancy: Some screenshots are copied into several batches. The screenshots folder keeps each one once.
translations.export.no_estimate: The estimate is not available for this project.
translations.export.history_pending: The package appears here when it is ready.
translations.export.history_empty: No packages yet. Create the first package when the review is ready.
translations.export.error_load: The package history could not be loaded. Reload the page to try again.
translations.export.error_create: The package could not be created. Try again.
translations.export.failed_default: This package was not created. Create a new package.
translations.new_project.invalid_summary: Some project details are not valid. Correct the highlighted fields.
translations.new_project.name_error: The name is too long. Use at most 120 characters.
translations.new_project.language_help: “auto” detects it; or enter a code such as “en” or “it”.
translations.new_project.language_error: This is not a language code. Enter “auto” or a two- or three-letter code.
translations.new_project.description_help: Context that helps reviewers understand the video.
translations.new_project.description_error: The description is too long. Use at most 500 characters.
translations.new_project.glossary_help: Names and terms the speakers use, one per line. The transcription favors their spelling. Put the most important first: a long list is cut after about 500 characters.
translations.new_project.glossary_error_count: The glossary has too many terms. Use at most 200.
translations.new_project.glossary_error_length: A term is too long. Use at most 80 characters per line.
translations.new_project.file_help: MP4, WebM, MOV or MKV. The video is stored only on this computer.
translations.new_project.upload_help: The whole video is checked before the next step.
translations.new_project.stored: The video is stored. Processing transcribes the audio, extracts screenshots and links them to transcript segments.
translations.new_project.takes_time: Processing can take several minutes. You can follow it and cancel it on the next screen.
translations.new_project.error_open: This project could not be opened. Go back to projects and try again.

translations.new_project.error_drop_one: Drop one video at a time.

translations.not_found.title: Page not found
translations.not_found.help: The link may be wrong, or the project was deleted.
translations.processing.title: Processing
translations.processing.cancelled_notice: Processing was cancelled. The original video is kept, so you can retry processing.
translations.processing.done_help: Processing is done. Open the review to check segments and screenshots.
translations.processing.not_processed: This project has not been processed yet. Processing runs on this computer.
translations.processing.no_video: This project has no video. Upload a video before processing.

translations.processing.error_start: Processing could not be started or followed. Try again to reload the project.
translations.processing.error_cancel: Processing could not be cancelled. Try again in a moment.
translations.projects.title: Projects
translations.projects.empty_help_record: Record your screen, or create a project and upload a screen recording.
translations.projects.sort.name: Name A–Z
translations.projects.no_match: No project matches these filters. Change the search or the filters.
translations.projects.delete_message: The video, transcript, screenshots and packages of this project are deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
translations.projects.error_unreachable: Narrastep could not reach its local service. Check that it is running, then try again.
translations.recorder.title: Record
translations.recorder.unsupported: This browser cannot record the screen. Open Narrastep in its desktop window, Chrome or Edge.
translations.recorder.system_audio.help: The sound of the computer, such as the other people in a call, is not recorded. To include it, choose the screen again and select "Share system audio" for an entire screen or "Share tab audio" for a tab. Otherwise the recording keeps only the microphone.
translations.recorder.system_audio.help_desktop: The sound of the computer, such as the other people in a call, is not recorded. The desktop window captures it only on Windows. Otherwise the recording keeps only the microphone.
translations.recorder.system_audio.notice_windows: On Windows the recording takes the sound of every application, also notification sounds. Mute notifications while recording.
translations.recorder.mic.blocked_help: The microphone is blocked. Allow it in the site settings of the browser, then select Use microphone again.
translations.recorder.mic.missing_help: No microphone was found. Connect one, then select Use microphone again.
translations.recorder.mic.failed_help: The microphone could not be opened. Close other programs that use it, then try again.
translations.recorder.consent: Tell everyone you record, for example the other people in a call, and get their consent before you start.
translations.recorder.headset: Use a headset: with speakers the microphone records the call a second time.
translations.recorder.need_audio: Turn on the microphone or share system audio: a recording without sound cannot be transcribed.
translations.recorder.retrying: Narrastep cannot reach its local service. It keeps the recorded parts and tries again.
translations.recorder.keep_open: You can work in other programs. Keep this window open until you stop.
translations.recorder.saving_text: Saving the recording. Narrastep joins the parts into one video; this takes a few seconds.
translations.recorder.interrupted_text: This recording stopped before it was saved. Save what was uploaded, or discard it.
translations.recorder.name: Recording name (optional)
translations.recorder.no_processing: Saving does not start processing. The project appears in Projects as Not processed.
translations.recorder.error_upload: The recording stopped because a part could not be stored. Save what was recorded, or discard it.
translations.recorder.error_open: This recording could not be opened. Go back to projects and try again.
translations.recorder.already_saved: This recording is already saved. Open it from Projects.
translations.recorder.error_start: The recording could not start. Check that Narrastep is running, then try again.
translations.recorder.error_format: This browser cannot record in a format Narrastep accepts. Use the desktop window, Chrome or Edge.
translations.recorder.discard_message: The recording and its project are deleted from this computer. This cannot be undone.
translations.recorder.error_discard: The recording could not be discarded. Try again.
translations.recorder.leave_message: The recording stops. Parts already uploaded are kept, and the project appears in Projects as Recording interrupted.
translations.recorder.saved_text: “{$NAME}” is in Projects as Not processed. Process it when you are ready.
translations.recorder.screen_ended: Screen sharing ended. Choose the screen again.
translations.recorder.screen_denied: No screen was shared. Choose screen to try again.
translations.recorder.screen_failed: The screen could not be captured. Try again, or use the desktop window, Chrome or Edge.
translations.recorder.error_join: The recorded parts could not be joined into a video. Try to save again, or discard the recording.
translations.recorder.error_save: The recording could not be saved. Check that Narrastep is running, then try again.

translations.storage.title: Storage
translations.storage.intro: Space used by your projects on this computer. Remove an original video after you have created its package.
translations.storage.empty: Projects you create will show their size here.
translations.storage.remove_message: This frees {$SIZE} on this computer. Packages you already created are kept. Afterwards the video cannot be played, exact frames cannot be recovered, and a new package can only use screenshots that are already saved as images. This cannot be undone.
translations.storage.remove_aria: Confirm removal of the original video of {$NAME}
translations.storage.blocked.no_video: This project has no original video yet.
translations.storage.blocked.busy: Wait until the project finishes its current work.
translations.storage.blocked.package_required: Create a package of the current review first.
translations.storage.error_unreachable: Narrastep could not reach its local service. Check that it is running, then try again.

translations.project_type.meeting.label: Meeting
translations.project_type.meeting.help: A discussion whose decisions and key points need a summary.
translations.project_type.tutorial.label: Tutorial
translations.project_type.tutorial.help: A procedure to repeat or teach, step by step.
translations.project_type.general.help: Anything else, such as a demo or a recorded note.
